In addition to last week's AirPods Pro 3 ongoing 25% discount and AirPods Max 2 price cut of $120, today's 9to5Toys Lunch main highlight is Amazon dropping the AirTag 2 to a new low, with the 4-pack now selling at $80 ($20 each). We also have the Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro down by $320 and 2TB M5 Pro down by $500. Don't miss Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card at an all-time low of $25 on Amazon, plus LG's 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor — a whopping $2,200 cheaper than the Apple Studio Display XDR (all-time low). See details below.

AirPods Pro 3 maintain 25% discount, next-gen not expected until 2027

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

Hello! AirTag 2 hits a new low again, with the 4-pack now at an all-time low of $80 ($20 each)

Good news everyone: Amazon is now offering the lowest price ever for the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 4-pack, at just $20 per tag.

Amazon is currently selling the AirTag 2 4-pack for $79.99 with shipping included.

We've been tracking this official bundle at $89.99 all last week, until yesterday Amazon dropped it again to $85, and now this week kicks off with an even bigger price cut. Original price $99, now nearly 20% off — while it may not seem like much, it's a pretty significant discount for the latest AirTag 2.

This bundle works out to just $20 per AirTag, the lowest price we've seen since its launch earlier this year.

The single AirTag 2 still maintains the $24 Prime member shipping-included low we saw last week, but the 4-pack has been slashed even further.

This $20-per-tag price matches the best open-box deal we saw at Best Buy last week.

Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro down $320 today, 2TB M5 Pro down $500

In addition to the ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods 2 hitting new lows, this week we also bring multiple notable deals on the latest MacBook Pro lineup. Amazon is still maintaining the $500 off on the 2TB M5 Pro, and we just spotted a $320 discount on this more affordable M5 MacBook Pro 24GB model. Details below.

If you prefer the more powerful M5 Pro, this model with $500 off on Amazon is absolutely worth a look. But if you want to go with the cheaper M5, B&H has a pretty attractive 14-inch 24GB/1TB configuration available:

B&H is once again offering the Apple 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB built-in storage, priced as low as $1,899 with shipping included.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (original price $2,219)
  • Includes upgraded 96W Apple Power Adapter

This machine was originally priced at $2,199, but B&H also throws in the official 96W Apple Power Adapter — which would cost you an extra $20 to configure on Apple's official website.

Amazon currently lists the same MacBook Pro configuration at $2,049, with the standard 70W charger included.

Overall, this B&H deal saves you $320, similar to previous picks, and is far more cost-effective than Amazon's current price.

As mentioned above, Amazon is still maintaining the substantial $500 discount on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB, priced at $2,699 — $500 off the $3,199 original price. This deal is expected to end soon.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card supports iOS and Android, slashed to an all-time low of $25 on Amazon

Anker recently launched its brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card — its first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — now at $25 for Prime members with shipping included, an all-time low on Amazon.

When this product first hit Amazon at the beginning of last month it was $35, with a slight $5 price drop by month's end. Now it's seeing its first significant price cut, hitting an all-time low on Amazon.

That's nearly a 30% discount, matching some of the best wallet tracker card deals we've seen this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards — starting at $35, with the Pro model at $45 featuring 16 months of battery life — but regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or card holder. I always carry one whenever I head out.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the important features, including wireless charging, while being compatible with either the Apple Find My platform or Google Find Hub. At just 1.7mm thin, it can reach up to 80 decibels for nearby locating — and of course can be loaded into the Find My and Find Hub apps to check its location on a map in real time.

Organize your desk with Anker's clever clamp-style power strip, now down to $58

LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits new low, a full $2,200 cheaper than Studio Display XDR

We just spotted the LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K monitor slashed to $1,099.99 with shipping included at B&H. This monitor was originally priced at $2,000, and over the past few months has gone as high as $1,597. Today's deal essentially matches the all-time low Amazon set earlier this month, and that low price is still valid. LG is also pricing it at $1,100 today, so even if one retailer runs out of stock, you still have plenty of options. At this price, the UltraFine evo 6K has a massive gap compared to Apple's display. The Studio Display XDR starts at $3,299, about $2,200 more expensive than the LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor. Even the standard Studio Display starts at $1,549, still about $500 more than this 32-inch 6K screen. See details below.

The LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K is a high-end workstation monitor aimed at creators who want a large, high-resolution screen but don't want to upgrade to Apple's more expensive options. Its 6,144 x 3,456 panel has over 21 million pixels at 224 PPI, providing ample space for editing timelines, full-resolution content, tools, and multiple windows. It also covers 99.5% Adobe RGB color gamut and supports VESA DisplayHDR 600 for better highlights and contrast. Connectivity is also comprehensive, including Thunderbolt 5, DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI, and USB-C. Mac users can use LG Studio Mode, with built-in color calibration presets to ensure color consistency for creative work. Overall, this is the ideal 6K choice for anyone who wants a truly large screen workspace but doesn't want to pay Apple's display prices.

If you don't want to spend over $1,000 on a new monitor, Woot also has several more affordable Samsung workstation monitor deals. Including the brand's M-series and other reasonably priced models, with prices starting from $118 after discounts.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker supports iPhone and Android, now just $20 (all-time low)
  • This compact UGREEN ultra-thin 45W Nexode Air charger is the thinnest one in my EDC, today just $27
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter slashed to $40 on Amazon (black or white)
  • Chipolo Google Find Hub wallet card with super button/remote shutter, down to $33
  • UGREEN MagFlow 25W Qi2.2 car charger drops back to $28 (original price $40)
  • Acer metal MagSafe golf cart mount slashed to $20 for Prime members with shipping included

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro down nearly 30%, hitting all-time low on Amazon (wired version discounted in sync)

In addition to a series of late-summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also selling the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro at its lowest price ever, and has reintroduced the wired version's all-time Prime Day low — both down nearly 30% from their regular pricing.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)

Although the brand later launched the $100 Ring Peephole Cam 2K, today's pick focuses on the multiple notable deals for its latest Pro-tier 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro has dropped back to its all-time Prime Day low, the first time since Prime Day at the end of June. In fact, this is the second time we've tracked this model dropping below $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro sees its first price cut, also hitting an all-time low of $180.

As mentioned above, both models are priced at $250, now down nearly 30% — the best deals and lowest prices we've seen.

Both models are largely the same, featuring up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K imaging to help you monitor your doorstep more clearly. The wireless version comes with a removable Ultra battery pack for easy charging and simpler installation (no wiring needed); the wired version offers 'uninterrupted power, uninterrupted protection'.

For details, refer to our launch coverage last September.

Best Buy launches new tech deals, NFL Sunday Ticket promotion, and preseason TV deals

Amazon cuts $120 on all five colors of AirPods Max 2 (one of the best prices)

This week's 60th anniversary promotion brings one of the best prices for the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon cutting $120 off across all five colors compared to regular pricing.

Amazon is currently selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with shipping included.

Compared to the previous generation's same $549 pricing, that's $120 saved — currently the best price we can find in brand-new condition from reputable retailers.

Best Buy has the Midnight black version available in 'Premium' open-box condition for $403.99 with shipping included, an even lower price — though perhaps not low enough to give up the brand-new version.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, unlike the previous generation which only got new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, Apple won't be updating the over-ear model at next month's new product event, so this week's $120 discount may be the lowest price for the latest and greatest Apple over-ear headphones for some time to come.

The only previous promotion with a lower price was this summer's Prime Day, when it was priced $30 below today's pick, but stock was very limited and unstable during the 4-day promotion.

Amazon sells 512GB iPad mini (Renewed Premium) at $450 off new pricing

Although we saw some iPad Air deals earlier this week, overall iPad discounts have been weak or nonexistent recently. However, we just spotted Amazon's top-tier Renewed Premium 512GB iPad mini slashed by a massive $450 from its new pricing.

Amazon is currently selling the 512GB iPad mini A17 — the latest model — for $449 with shipping included.

This iPad is priced at $899 brand new on Apple's official website, now available on Amazon directly for $450 less.

Worth noting, even before Apple's price hike, we've never seen this model drop below $679 in brand-new condition on Amazon.

Just a reminder — Amazon Renewed Premium is different from regular Renewed products or even 'Premium' condition refurbished devices:

  • Screen: No scratches, where applicable.
  • Body: No visible cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, etc.) when viewed from a distance of 12 inches.
  • Battery: Where batteries are included, battery capacity exceeds 90% of original battery life.
  • Accessories: Comes with generic or original accessories and packaging.
  • Guarantee: Renewed Premium products come with a 365-day return policy.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro down $220 (same as Prime Day deal)

Although the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my top choice for buying refurbished iPhones, Apple currently doesn't sell the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet — expected to wait until next month's launch of the 18 series. Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed has now dropped back to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new pricing.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed has always been the best current option for getting an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Not only do you save hundreds of dollars, you also get a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'over 90% original battery life' — while non-'Premium' refurbished products on Amazon only offer a 90-day warranty and don't have the same battery life guarantee.

Right now you can grab the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro for up to $220 off — the 512GB version is another $20 cheaper than our last pick:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (new original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (new original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (new original price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can get a practical iPhone 16 with 1 year of Apple warranty starting from $699, and the 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 starting from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than 17 series)
